contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin fragment. Nummus of the House of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left, Reece period 17, Aquilea mint; about three quarters of flan lost.. Obverse description: Bust diademed right. Obverse inscription: [--]ALEN (--). Revers edescription: Victory advancing left. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. In exergue: SMAQ[?S]. Diameter (in excess of): 11.5mm, Weight: 0.74gms, die axis: 6
